chunks: Ibn Fazzal, from Abu Jameel, from Sa'd ibn Tareef, from Al-Asbagh ibn Nubata, who said:
Amir Al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: 'The one who has a child, aspires.'

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (Title of Imam Ali)
key_terms.صَبَا: To aspire, yearn, or long for

ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali say about the effect of having children on a parent's aspirations?
ai.summary: In this concise narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) identifies the innate longing (*saba*) for one's children as a natural spiritual disposition, reflecting the deep emotional tether that serves as a source of hope and motivation. This insight underscores the psychological and spiritual dimensions of parenthood in Shia thought, where the child is viewed not merely as a responsibility but as a catalyst for parental aspiration and spiritual growth.
